answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Network caps new identities at 1 percent of established count per epoch, no exceptions. Trust accrues only through verified work; a crystal of clones pays full freight per head, audits fall like a steady voyage at 10 percent per epoch, and vault-weight accounts forfeit bond on first correlated fault. Verify once, price forever — the bond, not the ban, does the work.
